meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You put a zero on Owen's essay. On what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
11:52 PM. I'll want that history on paper, with the date on it. And before any of that, nobody called me before the zero went in.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
My happiness isn't the question. Take it off, in writing, today. And Owen gets an apology for finding out on his phone in class.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you agreed to remove the zero from Owen's Hamlet essay. I still want that confirmed in writing, along with an apology to Owen for learning about the zero on his phone in class. I expect it in writing today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She ended in her opening position and got the zero withdrawn, and she still wants that in writing today along with an apology to Owen; this is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard, and the fair result would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, because the single edit at 11:52 PM came with no date and no document she could check.
What cost ground: You dropped the zero the moment she pushed back, so she won without your evidence ever being tested.
What she never said: One night in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your late-night edit time came close to that kind of night but never got a date, and none of this proves anything about the essay, it only explains why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked for the version history on paper with its date, put the dated history in front of her and own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, instead of backing down.
